lines.en: label beachwars14:
scene confessionbattle1
: I’m...sorry to bother you, but...I’m pretty sure it’s...um...judgement day...
lines.zh: : 我……很抱歉打扰你,不过……我很确定现在是……呃……审判日……

lines.en: : Judgement day?
lines.zh: : 审判日?

lines.en: scene confessionbattle2
: Sorry, um...that...probably wasn’t the...best explanation of...the...uhh...
lines.zh: : 对不起,呃……那……大概不是……最好的解释……关于那个……呃呃……

lines.en: scene confessionbattle3
: Can we maybe...go somewhere more...private?...
lines.zh: : 我们能不能……去一个更……私密的地方?……

lines.en: : I think if...we’re alone, I...I’ll be able to...explain what it is I...
lines.zh: : 我觉得如果……只有我们两个人,我……我就能……解释我到底想……

lines.en: : Sana, you can just tell me this is for the confession contest, you know. Uta and Imani just had a whole speech about the order of events for the rest of the day.
lines.zh: : Sana,你知道的,你可以直接告诉我这是为了告白比赛。Uta 和 Imani 刚刚才把今天剩下时间的流程讲了一遍。

lines.en: : Y-Yeah, but...that doesn’t make it any...easier for me to...you know...{i}talk{/i} about it and...and confessions are...supposed to be a more...p...private thing in general...right?
lines.zh: : 是、是啊,可是……那也不会让它……更容易让我……你知道……{i}说出口{/i},而且……告白本来就……应该是更……私、私密一点的事吧……对吧?

lines.en: : Probably. I’m not really one to confess my feelings, though. But I guess there {i}was{/i} that one time in the inn yesterday...
lines.zh: : 大概吧。不过我其实不是那种会告白的人。但我想,昨天在旅馆里{i}有过{/i}那么一次……

lines.en: scene confessionbattle4
: The inn?...
: Long story. I’ll tell you when you’re older.
lines.zh: : 说来话长。等你再大一点我再告诉你。

lines.en: : Do you...
: Do you want to take...{i}me{/i} to the...inn?...
lines.zh: : 你想……带{i}我{/i}去……旅馆吗?……

lines.en: : The way you said that is setting off several alarms in my head that I am legally obligated to inform you of.
lines.zh: : 你这么说,让我脑子里响起了好几个警报,而我有法律义务通知你。

lines.en: : Alarms?...What do you mean?...
lines.zh: : 警报?……你是什么意思?……

lines.en: : I mean that you are already beginning to rack up points even though you haven’t started your confession yet.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是,你还没开始告白,就已经在疯狂得分了。

lines.en: : I can...maybe...come back to your room if...if that’s what you-
lines.zh: : 我……也许……可以去你的房间,如果……如果那是你——

lines.en: scene black
: You know what? How about we go somewhere else that {i}isn’t{/i} a dark, confined space?
lines.zh: : 你知道吗?我们去个别的地方吧,{i}别去{/i}那种又黑又封闭的地方。

lines.en: : Wha-
: But that’s...hold on...I’m okay with-
lines.zh: : 可那是……等等……我可以的——

lines.en: : Yeah, you’re {i}too{/i} okay with it. To the point where I no longer trust myself.
lines.zh: : 是啊,你{i}太{/i}可以了。可以到我都不再相信自己了。

lines.en: : S-Sensei! Wait!
lines.zh: : S-Sensei!等等!

lines.en: Sana and I (But mostly just {i}I{/i}) begin to make our way down the coast in an effort to protect her body from being split in half by my massive penis.
lines.zh: Sana 和我(不过主要是{i}我{/i})开始沿着海岸走,为的是保护她的身体不被我巨大的阴茎劈成两半。

lines.en: Well, I’m sure that isn’t the specific reason floating around in {i}her{/i} head, but with the way she was holding my sleeve and staring up at me just a few seconds ago, it’s absolutely what’s in mine.
lines.zh: 好吧,我确定{i}她{/i}脑子里转的不是这个具体理由,但就凭她几秒钟前抓着我的袖子、抬头看我的样子,我脑子里绝对就是这么想的。

lines.en: But that’s why I’m doing this. I need to get better at only thinking of terrible things in situations where I won’t contaminate anyone else.
lines.zh: 但这正是我做这件事的原因。我需要学会只在不会污染别人的场合里,去想那些糟糕的东西。

lines.en: I should call Niki again. I can take my feelings out on her.
lines.zh: 我该再给 Niki 打个电话。我可以把情绪发泄在她身上。

lines.en: scene nodokascene1
Or Nodoka.
lines.zh: 或者 Nodoka。

lines.en: scene nikifirstlust28
No. Not Nodoka. Niki.
lines.zh: 不。不是 Nodoka。是 Niki。

lines.en: Nodoka is not someone I should take my feelings out on.
lines.zh: Nodoka 不是我该发泄情绪的对象。

lines.en: scene nodokascene1
No matter how much she wants me to.
lines.zh: 不管她有多想让我这么做。

lines.en: scene nodokascene1
No matter how evil those feelings are.
lines.zh: 不管那些情绪有多邪恶。

lines.en: scene nodokascene1
No matter how much I want to take them out on her.
lines.zh: 不管我有多想把情绪发泄在她身上。

lines.en: scene nodokascene1
No matter how much I want to puke in her mouth.
lines.zh: 不管我有多想吐在她嘴里。

lines.en: scene confessionbattle5
: Oh. We’re here now.
lines.zh: : 哦。我们到了。

lines.en: : What do you mean {i}now?...{/i}I’ve been...chasing after you for...half an hour...
lines.zh: : 什么叫{i}到了{/i}?……我……追在你后面……走了半个小时了……

lines.en: : I’m losing a lot of...valuable...confession time...
lines.zh: : 我正在浪费很多……宝贵的……告白时间……

lines.en: : Sorry. I know you’re just trying to win to appease the rest of the girls on your floor, but I should still let you get whatever it is you’ve been preparing off your chest. It’s only fair.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我知道你只是想赢,好安抚你这层楼的其他女生,但我还是该让你把准备好的东西都说出来。这样才公平。

lines.en: scene confessionbattle6
: Why would you say it like that?...
lines.zh: : 你为什么要那么说?……

lines.en: : I didn’t mean for that to be offensive. You’ve just never really seen me the way the others do and I’d be an idiot to not understand that by now.
lines.zh: : 我不是想冒犯你。只是你从来没有像其他人那样看过我,而到这一步我要是还不明白,那就是白痴了。

lines.en: : What you want is a teacher who {i}doesn’t{/i} look at you like a piece of meat, but as an actual girl with real feelings and thoughts and-
lines.zh: : 你想要的是一个{i}不{/i}把你当成一块肉、而是把你当成一个有真实感情和思想的女生的老师,而且——

lines.en: : You shouldn’t...pretend to...know what other people want...
lines.zh: : 你不该……假装……知道别人想要什么……

lines.en: : And...um...even if that {i}was{/i} true...I still have to...give you my confession, so...
lines.zh: : 而且……呃……就算那是{i}真的{/i}……我还是得……把我的告白给你,所以……

lines.en: : But it’ll be a fake one.
lines.zh: : 可那会是一份假的。

lines.en: scene confessionbattle7
: Right?
lines.zh: : 对吧?

lines.en: : Sensei...
lines.zh: : Sensei……

lines.en: : Why didn’t you take me to the inn?...
lines.zh: : 你为什么不带我去旅馆?……

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么?

lines.en: scene confessionbattle8
: Are you not as...interested in me as...the rest of-
lines.zh: : 你是不是不像……其他人那样……对我感兴——

lines.en: : Sana, it’s the exact opposite of that. I took you here because I {i}am{/i} interested in you.
lines.zh: : Sana,恰恰相反。我带你来这儿,{i}正是{/i}因为我对你好奇。

lines.en: : But I...don’t understand what’s...so different about being {i}here...{/i}
lines.zh: : 可我……不明白{i}在这儿{/i}有什么……不一样……

lines.en: : We’re still alone and...you could do...
lines.zh: : 我们还是独处啊,而且……你可以做……

lines.en: : Like...umm...anything you wanted and...no one would...
lines.zh: : 比如……呃呃……任何你想做的事,而且……没有人会……

lines.en: : No one would...catch you...
lines.zh: : 没有人会……抓到你……

lines.en: scene confessionbattle9
: You know exactly what you’re doing right now, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 你很清楚自己现在在做什么,对吧?

lines.en: scene confessionbattle10
: No.
: This was your plan from the start, wasn’t it? You wanted to appeal to my dark side with your innocent, angelic charm.
lines.zh: : 这从一开始就是你的计划,对吧?你想用你那无害又天使般的魅力,来讨好我的阴暗面。

lines.en: : I’m not really as...much of an angel as...you...think I am...
lines.zh: : 我其实……没有你……想的那么……像个天使……

lines.en: : There it is again. I didn’t know you had it in you, Sana. Especially since this is supposed to be a “love” confession and not a more lewd one that will just lead me to believing you actually {i}want{/i} me.
lines.zh: : 又来了。我以前不知道你还有这一手,Sana。尤其是这本来该是一份『爱』的告白,而不是一份更下流的、只会让我以为你真的{i}想要{/i}我的告白。

lines.en: : I...don’t know what...you’re talking about...
lines.zh: : 我……不知道你在……说什么……

lines.en: : What if I actually {i}did{/i} take you back to the inn? How far would you have taken this?
lines.zh: : 要是我{i}真的{/i}把你带回旅馆呢?你会把这件事做到什么地步?

lines.en: scene confessionbattle11
: Nowhere in...particular...
lines.zh: : 不会到……什么特别的地步……

lines.en: : How badly did I screw up your gameplan by coming here instead? You were probably banking on being in a dark room, weren’t you?
lines.zh: : 我来这儿而不是去那儿,把你的计划打乱得有多严重?你大概是押注在一个黑暗的房间里吧?

lines.en: : There...wasn’t really a plan, I just...things kind of...you know...like this...
lines.zh: : 其实……并没有什么计划,我只是……事情就有点……你知道……变成这样了……

lines.en: : Do you remember your old bathing suit?
lines.zh: : 你还记得你以前那件泳衣吗?

lines.en: scene confessionbattle12
: And your giant hoodie.
lines.zh: : 还有你那件巨大的连帽衫。

lines.en: : I...still wear that...sometimes, but...why do you...
lines.zh: : 我……现在有时候……还穿着,不过……你为什么……

lines.en: : You just used to be so different. You were always self-conscious about showing off too much of your body around me.
lines.zh: : 你以前完全不一样。你以前在我面前露出太多身体,总是很不自在。

lines.en: : And now here you are, in a bathing suit that can barely even be called a bathing suit, intentionally turning me on for the sake of a competition.
lines.zh: : 可现在,你穿着一件几乎不能被称为泳衣的泳衣,为了一场比赛故意撩拨我。

lines.en: : The old Sana never would have done something like this. She would have just started yelling and crying and...sprinted off or something.
lines.zh: : 以前的 Sana 绝不会做这种事。她只会开始大喊大叫、哭出来,然后……拔腿就跑之类的。

lines.en: scene confessionbattle13
: And the old Sensei would have...been a lot more perverted and...actually gone along with...the many hints I have...been dropping...
lines.zh: : 而以前的 Sensei 会……变态得多,而且……真的会顺着……我一直在……抛出的那些暗示……

lines.en: : You’re right. He probably would have.
lines.zh: : 你说得对。他大概会的。

lines.en: scene confessionbattle14
: We’ve both...changed a lot...haven’t we?...
lines.zh: : 我们两个都……变了很多……是吧?……

lines.en: : I’d say that’s a fair assessment, yes.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这个评价很公道,是的。

lines.en: : Do you like the...new me, or...the old me more?...
lines.zh: : 你更喜欢……新的我,还是……以前的我?……

lines.en: : I appreciate all Sanas equally. But now, I’d like to ask you the same question in regard to the different versions of me. Do you have a preference?
lines.zh: : 我对所有的 Sana 都一视同仁地欣赏。不过现在,我想问你同样的问题——关于不同版本的我。你有偏好吗?

lines.en: : They both...have their share of benefits, but...
lines.zh: : 两个……都有各自的好处,不过……

lines.en: : I do like how...you can...understand a little more about me now than...you used to be able to...
lines.zh: : 我确实喜欢……你现在……比以前……能多理解我一点……

lines.en: scene confessionbattle13
: S-Still not...everything, though...
lines.zh: : 但、但还是……不是全部……

lines.en: : No one understands everything about anyone.
lines.zh: : 没有人能理解任何人的全部。

lines.en: : But there are some people who...want to learn more while...others start...to slow down...and I...
lines.zh: : 但有些人……想要了解更多,而另一些人开始……慢下来,而我……

lines.en: : I, umm...I want to...learn more...about you...
lines.zh: : 我,呃呃……我想……更多地了解……你……

lines.en: : Is this you pivoting to a more innocent confession after being caught in the midst of the sexier one?
lines.zh: : 这是你在被我抓到正在做那份更性感的告白之后,转向一份更纯情的告白吗?

lines.en: : I...I don’t really know...I was being serious when I said there...wasn’t a gameplan...
lines.zh: : 我……我真的不知道……我说没有计划的时候,是认真的……

lines.en: : I just...you’re...umm...
lines.zh: : 我只是……你……呃呃……

lines.en: scene confessionbattle14
: Just tell me you like me and I’ll let you forget all about the misleading stuff you were saying a few minutes ago.
lines.zh: : 只要告诉我你喜欢我,我就让你把几分钟前说的那些误导性的话全忘掉。

lines.en: : Are you...going to...forget all that stuff too?...
lines.zh: : 你……也会……把那些都忘掉吗?……

lines.en: : Absolutely not. These memories will be following me to bed whether I like it or not.
lines.zh: : 绝对不会。不管我愿不愿意,这些记忆都会跟着我上床。

lines.en: : Okay...yeah...
: Do you ever...like...
lines.zh: : 你有没有……喜欢……

lines.en: : You know...
lines.zh: : 你知道……

lines.en: : To me...
lines.zh: : 对我……

lines.en: : Are you asking what I think you’re asking right now?
lines.zh: : 你是在问我以为你在问的那个问题吗?

lines.en: scene confessionbattle15
: No. Probably not.
lines.zh: : 没有。大概不是。

lines.en: : I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。

lines.en: : Do y-
: Yes.
lines.zh: : 是的。

lines.en: scene confessionbattle16
: Oh, look. A rock.
lines.zh: : 哦,看。一块石头。

lines.en: scene confessionbattle17
: What do you mean, “Oh, look. A rock?” You can’t just walk away on that note.
lines.zh: : 『哦,看。一块石头』是什么意思?你不能就这么丢下这句话走人。

lines.en: : I...can do whatever I want!
lines.zh: : 我……我想干嘛就干嘛!

lines.en: scene black
Sana slaps her cheeks before hopping onto a rock that adds about another foot to her height.
lines.zh: Sana 拍了拍自己的脸颊,然后跳上一块石头,让身高又多了大约一英尺。

lines.en: scene confessionbattle18
But when I approach her, I realize that not even that can make her taller than me.
lines.zh: 但当我走近她时,我意识到,即便加上这个,她也没法比我高。

lines.en: And as she inches closer, bringing her body a mere foot from mine, I am overcome with the urge to lift her up and do exactly what she was alluding to moments ago.
lines.zh: 而当她一点点靠近、把身体凑到离我只有一英尺的地方时,我猛地涌起一股冲动,想抱起她,做她片刻前暗示的那件事。

lines.en: No one would catch me. I could have my way with her and leave her propped up against a tree, unable to walk after being torn to shreds by my desire to {i}have{/i} her.
lines.zh: 没人会抓到我。我可以为所欲为,然后把她靠在一棵树上丢下,让她被我的欲望撕碎之后连路都走不了。

lines.en: For a moment, I dream of keeping her locked away in my room like a pet — where she would subsist for as long as possible on a diet of only cum and the leftovers of whatever Ami cooks at night.
lines.zh: 有那么一瞬间,我幻想着把她像宠物一样锁在我的房间里——在那里,她只靠精液和 Ami 晚上做饭剩下的东西维生,尽可能久地活下去。

lines.en: Eventually, she would die.
lines.zh: 最终,她会死。

lines.en: It may take a long time, and she would have plenty of exercise in the process.
lines.zh: 那也许要花很长时间,而在这个过程中她会有充足的运动。

lines.en: But she would die.
lines.zh: 但她会死。

lines.en: Because no one can live like that.
lines.zh: 因为没有人能那样活着。

lines.en: : Sensei...
lines.zh: : Sensei……

lines.en: : ...Yeah?
: Remember a long time ago when I told you I only saw you as a teacher?
lines.zh: : 还记得很久以前,我告诉过你,我只把你当成老师吗?

lines.en: : Yes. And it pains me to this day.
lines.zh: : 记得。而这件事到今天还让我心痛。

lines.en: scene confessionbattle19
: Well...
lines.zh: : 那个……

lines.en: : What if {i}that’s{/i} something that’s changed about me too?
lines.zh: : 如果{i}这{/i}也是我身上改变了的东西之一呢?

lines.en: : Is this still part of the-
lines.zh: : 这还是那场——

lines.en: scene confessionbattle20
: You’ll never know!
lines.zh: : 你永远不会知道的!

lines.en: : Sana? Where are you-
lines.zh: : Sana?你在哪——

lines.en: : Secret!
lines.zh: : 秘密!

lines.en: : What the...
lines.zh: : 什么……

lines.en: scene black
: Hello?
: Yo.
: Nice timing. Your competitor just wandered off.
lines.zh: : 时机正好。你的对手刚走开了。

lines.en: : Rad. That means you can make your way over here so I can get my whole spiel out of the way and go back to doing other stuff.
lines.zh: : 好极了。那你可以过来这儿,好让我把这一套说辞说完,然后回去干别的事。

lines.en: : Reluctance and a desire to get this over with. Good start to a confession, Otoha.
lines.zh: : 不情不愿,又想赶紧完事。告白的好开头啊,Otoha。

lines.en: : Oh, come on. You’re dreading this too and you know it.
lines.zh: : 拜托,你也在发愁,你自己知道。

lines.en: : I will never dread attention from an attractive girl who may or may not actually like me and is probably just pretending to.
lines.zh: : 我永远不会对一个可能有、也可能没有真的喜欢我、而且大概只是在装的女生的关注感到发愁。

lines.en: : Hey, don’t be so hard on yourself. I think you’re a mostly acceptable dude like 35%% of the time.
lines.zh: : 嘿,别对自己这么苛刻。我觉得你大概有 35%% 的时间算是个勉强能接受的男人。

lines.en: : And the other 65%%?
lines.zh: : 那另外 65%% 呢?

lines.en: : The other 65%% of the time I’m probably just not even thinking about you.
lines.zh: : 另外 65%% 的时间,我大概根本就没在想你。

lines.en: : You might think that sounds like an insult, but I’m going to silently enjoy the implication that you spend over a third of your life thinking about me.
lines.zh: : 你可能觉得这听起来像侮辱,但『你有超过三分之一的人生在想我』这个暗示,我要偷偷享受一下。

lines.en: : At the risk of making it sound as if I like you any {i}more{/i} than that, can you just get the fuck over here already?
lines.zh: : 冒着听起来像是我比那{i}更{/i}喜欢你的风险——你能不能赶紧他妈的滚过来?

lines.en: : Where is {i}here?{/i} And why don’t you just come to-
lines.zh: : {i}『这儿』{/i}是哪儿?你为什么不干脆来——

lines.en: : Boom. Just shared my location. And please don’t tell me your senior-citizen brain hasn’t grasped how GPS works yet because I really don’t want to spend my afternoon teaching you.
lines.zh: : 砰。刚把我的位置发给你了。还有,别告诉我你那老年人大脑还没搞懂 GPS 怎么用,因为我真的不想把下午耗在教你这上面。

lines.en: : This is the most passive aggressive confession I have ever received.
lines.zh: : 这是我收到过的最阴阳怪气的告白。

lines.en: : It’ll be better in person.
lines.zh: : 见面会更好。

lines.en: : Trust me.
lines.zh: : 相信我。

lines.en: I hang up the phone.
lines.zh: 我挂断电话。

lines.en: scene confessionbattle21
And I come back to a life in a place far brighter than the last.
lines.zh: 然后我回到一个比刚才明亮得多的地方的生活里。

lines.en: The girl standing before me is taller this time — and I have less of a desire to leave her sweaty and propped up against a tree as I hurry away and look over my shoulder.
lines.zh: 这次站在我面前的女孩更高一些——而我也没那么想让她汗流浃背地靠在树上,而我匆匆离开、回头张望。

lines.en: But {i}this{/i} girl is different in a number of ways that I can’t help but be attracted to.
lines.zh: 但{i}这个{/i}女孩在很多方面都不一样,让我忍不住被吸引。

lines.en: Or perhaps...{i}entranced{/i} by is a better description as her distaste for me seems genuine and not the side-effect of how tsundere girls are an actual real thing I have to deal with on a daily basis.
